## 3. VW-03.02 — Implement within-workout fatigue state machine (EWMA per exercise)
**Priority:** critical | **Status:** pending | **Category:** implementation | **Mode:** auto
**Workstream:** VW-03 - VBT Autoregulation Engine
**Virtual States:** +READY, +ELIGIBLE

**Description:**
The fatigue state machine is Phase 3 of the VBT autoregulation spec. It applies EWMA (F_new = clamp(λ*F_old + (1-λ)*g(FI_set, intensity, volume))) per exercise after each set to track within-workout fatigue accumulation. This is the prerequisite for load autoregulation.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- FatigueState accumulator class implemented with EWMA formula as specified
- λ (smoothing factor) configurable per exercise type
- g() function maps (FatigueIndex, intensity, volume) to a fatigue contribution scalar
- clamp() keeps fatigue in [0, 1] range
- Unit tests: monotonic increase under repeated sets, recovery behavior, edge cases at λ=0 and λ=1
- Integrated with the analytics pipeline via a setCompleted() hook

**Ref:** workout-analytics/docs/vbt-autoregulation-spec.md (Phase 3, section 7), workout-analytics/src/analytics/, workout-analytics/src/models/
